rules.reason_if_failed: You can only claim Bereavement Support Payment if your partner has died

rules.description: Claimant must be under State Pension age when partner died
rules.reason_if_failed: You must have been under State Pension age when your partner died

rules.description: Must be living in UK or country that pays bereavement benefits
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be living in the UK or a country that pays bereavement benefits

rules.description: Must have been married, in civil partnership, or living together as if married
rules.reason_if_failed: You must have been married to your partner, in a civil partnership, or living with them as if you were married

rules.description: Partner must have paid sufficient National Insurance contributions or died from work-related cause
rules.reason_if_failed: Your partner must have paid sufficient National Insurance contributions, or died from an accident at work or work-related disease
You cannot claim Bereavement Support Payment if you are in prison

rules.description: Must claim within 21 months of partner's death
rules.reason_if_failed: You usually need to claim within 21 months of your partner's death. Contact the Bereavement Service if the cause of death was only recently confirmed.

rules.description: If living together (not married), must have Child Benefit or be pregnant
rules.reason_if_failed: If you were living together as if married, you must have been getting Child Benefit for a child, or have been pregnant when your partner died

explanation_template: Bereavement Support Payment eligibility: {outcome}. Payment rate: {rate}. Claim timing affects payment amount.

edge_cases.action: Route to Widowed Parent's Allowance instead. Hand off to specialist advisor.

edge_cases.description: Death occurred over 21 months ago but cause only recently confirmed
edge_cases.action: Hand off to Bereavement Service helpline for manual assessment.
Route to International Pension Centre. Different application process required.

edge_cases.description: Claimant will reach State Pension age within 18 months
edge_cases.action: Warn that monthly payments may be reduced. Proceed with application but flag for assessment.

edge_cases.description: Unsure if partner paid sufficient NI contributions
edge_cases.action: Proceed with application. DWP will check NI record during assessment.
Warn that payment amount will be reduced. One-off payment reduced/removed, fewer monthly payments available.
